_comment: Third-party software built into the server image outside NuGet and npm (plan 2.7b, ruling Q9; Task 9 fix round 1), stated by hand: no package manager file lists it. docker/Dockerfile builds the PostgreSQL client tools from the official source tarball (PG_VERSION, pinned with its SHA-256) and copies only pg_dump, pg_restore and libpq into the image, with PostgreSQL's COPYRIGHT at /usr/share/doc/postgresql/COPYRIGHT; no distribution package is installed for them. The version below must equal PG_VERSION of the Dockerfile (LicensesTests checks it). Copyright from COPYRIGHT and the pg_dump sources (the notice of Philip Warner is a condition of its use), checked 2026-11-21. OpenSSL, zlib, zstd and LZ4, which the tools link, are libraries of the aspnet base image and are not added by xrmverse.

packages.description: PostgreSQL client tools pg_dump and pg_restore, and the libpq library
